note: USACE Melvern Lake campground on an open peninsula; the non-electric sites ring the shore with open grass and beach to the water, the electric loops sit inland and on the wooded south tip. --Claude
summary: rec.gov 233657: 43 family sites (30 A $24, 50 A $26, non-electric $20, May-Sep tables), max 65 ft, showers, flush/vault toilets, dump; 14-night cap. Lakefront kept on the shore-side non-electric sites 12-18. Phone 785-549-3318 confirmed.
flags: Lakefront KEPT (per-site check): non-electric sites 12-18 sit on spurs on the lake side of the loop road along the east and south shore, ~15-30 m of open grass and sand beach to the water with no road or day use between (Esri, 260 m frame). Sites 10, 20-22 are ~40-60 m back; the electric loops (01-08 road row, 31-50 interior loop, 23-30 wooded south tip) are 60-150 m from the water and view only. So lakefront rests on about 7 non-electric sites; the electric sites a hookup-wanting guest books are lakeview at best.
